title: Career Roadmap · Draughtsman
summary: A Draughtsman converts engineering and building concepts into accurate technical drawings, plans and models used by architects, engineers, manufacturers and construction teams.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 for the ITI pathway; Science and Mathematics are especially useful for mechanical drafting and further technical study.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Mathematics supports diploma and degree alternatives; requirements vary by course.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Technical drawing, geometry, measurement, building plans, machine components and CAD.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Spatial reasoning, precision, scale drawing and computer literacy.

rows.text: Building plans, construction drawings and civil layouts
Machine parts, assembly drawings and manufacturing plans
Civil drafting, site plans and construction documentation
Mechanical CAD, production drawings and design support

blocks.text: The DGT lists Draughtsman (Civil) as a two-year CTS trade with Class 10 as the published entry qualification. Draughtsman Mechanical is also listed as two years, with Science and Mathematics or an accepted equivalent vocational subject specified. Verify current official notification.

blocks.text: Build a drawing portfolio, complete practical assignments and practise drawing checks.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Construction, architecture, infrastructure, manufacturing, fabrication, engineering consultancy, real estate and industrial design.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Technical drawing, dimensioning, projections, scale interpretation, drawing standards, accuracy and revision control.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: AutoCAD or equivalent CAD software; discipline-specific 3D CAD tools; BIM software for building projects; spreadsheets and PDF markup tools.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT Draughtsman trade certificate.
Official software-provider training or certifications relevant to the role.
CAD / BIM courses with practical portfolio work.
Advanced drafting or design training in the chosen discipline.

blocks.text: Software credentials are useful additions, not substitutes for a recognized qualification or practical drafting ability.

blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and New Zealand.

items.text: BCIT — Canada; building, civil or mechanical technology programs.
TAFE NSW — Australia; drafting, design and construction-related courses.

New Zealand polytechnic providers — construction or engineering technology courses.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic records, language proficiency where applicable, subject prerequisites and software or portfolio evidence for some programs. Check official course listings and international-student eligibility.

blocks.text: CAD Technician, Civil Draughtsperson, Mechanical Draughtsperson, BIM Technician and Engineering Design Technician.
